insights.title: Malik Willis gets a stacked red flag: offensive-line grade and schedule all point the same way
insights.body: Pass protection tier 5 of 5. Season slate lean -1. Late-season weather flag. Miami projects with one of the league's weakest offensive lines. A rough schedule compounds Miami's weak-line, downgraded-receiver ecosystem; the projected haircut to team passing expectation is ten to fifteen percent.
